question: Oda-sensei, if CP9 and the Seven Warlords of the Sea are out, could you put him in the Straw Hat Pirates? Junior
answer: KNOCK IT OFF!! THAT'S ENOUGH OF THAT!! Hahh, hahh... I'm sorry, I shouldn't be getting out of sorts over a couple of children. As a matter of fact, everyone, I've received a letter of thanks from someone. It feels so wonderful to be thanked. Please see below.
name: Nezumi Junior
